_cursorSupportedEvents.stop: YES — equivalent to Claude Code Stop. Uses followup_message (no decision:block).
_cursorSupportedEvents.afterFileEdit: YES — fires after file edits, similar to PostToolUse[Edit|Write].
_cursorSupportedEvents.SessionStart: NO — Cursor has no session lifecycle hooks.
_cursorSupportedEvents.UserPromptSubmit: NO — Cursor has no prompt interception hook.
_cursorSupportedEvents.PreToolUse: NO — Cursor has no pre-tool-use hook.
_cursorSupportedEvents.PostToolUse_Task: NO — Cursor does not expose Task/Agent tool events.
_cursorSupportedEvents.PostToolUse_MCP: NO — Cursor does not expose MCP tool events to hooks.
_cursorSupportedEvents.SubagentStart: NO — Cursor has no subagent lifecycle hooks.
_cursorSupportedEvents.SubagentStop: NO — Cursor has no subagent lifecycle hooks.
_cursorSupportedEvents.statusLine: NO — Cursor has no custom status line support.

_notes: Cursor hooks MUST use followup_message instead of decision:block (supportsDecisionBlock() returns false for Cursor).
Cursor hook format: { command: string } (flat, no matcher or type fields).
All registered hooks below are Cursor-compatible and use followup_message paths.
